title: The Portrait of the Marlowe Estate
author: August Dunmore
blurb: Isandro Eriksen, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
